svg.title: Animation under load
svg.desc: Engine remeasurement on 2026-11-14 against the reconstructed intermediate baseline. Each workload uses a separate zero-based absolute scale, with endpoints printed below its marks. Whiskers show recorded minimum and maximum, not confidence intervals. SVG · 12 reshaping lenses: previous median 27.2743 FPS, range 26.6401 to 28.0175; current median 59.2515 FPS, range 56.0014 to 60.0025. SVG · 24 reshaping lenses: previous median 16.1836 FPS, range 15.5654 to 16.3642; current median 35.3978 FPS, range 30.6229 to 36.8489. SVG · 24 cached movement lenses: previous median 45.9441 FPS, range 43.0011 to 46.1184; current median 45.811 FPS, range 45.2523 to 46.1184. WebGL · 24 reshaping lenses: previous median 60.0015 FPS, range 60.0015 to 60.003; current median 60.003 FPS, range 60.0015 to 60.0045. WebGL · 24 cached movement lenses: previous median 60.0025 FPS, range 60.0015 to 60.004; current median 60.0025 FPS, range 60.0015 to 60.004. 2026-11-14 · 5 trials/build · Chromium 157. Intermediate baseline · results vary by scene
